brief.question: Review and improve mixerCraft's core: audio track (stem) playback, accompaniment assembly by harmony and by instrument, library organization, visual consistency, and the exercise library.
brief.purpose: The person (non-coder) owns this Electron/React app for bass study and wants its basic features reviewed and made solid.
constraints: Keep the existing stack (Electron 33, React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Vitest)
Edit in place; don't delete user work
brief.done_when: Concrete fixes/improvements in the five areas are implemented, typecheck+tests+build pass, and a summary of what was reviewed and changed is given.
